headline: Approved retirement applications and return of contributions for six people, plus 2027 meeting dates.
summary: The October 19, 2026 minutes were approved as part of the consent agenda. Chris Rowlins gave the City of Burlington Employees Retirement System October 2026 Monthly Performance Update.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the October 19, 2026 minutes and the 2027 meeting dates, unanimously.
Approved return of contributions for Morgan Donhoff, John T. Jacobs and Tanner D. Studlack, unanimously.
Approved retirement applications for Lance E. Desautels, Jeffrey D. Bower and Stephen Burroughs, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Board Member Olsen, seconded by Board Member Parker, to adopt the consent agenda and take the actions indicated. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Board Member Kasti, seconded by Board Member Matson, to approve the return of contributions as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Board Member Kasti, seconded by Board Member Olsen, to approve the retirement applications. Motion passed unanimously.
